en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

ja: 指揮者のために。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

en: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
u.src: 1  The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

p.src: 2  Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

en: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
u.src: 2  Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

p.src: 3  There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

ja: こえない言葉も、 言語もない。
en: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.
u.src: 3  There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

p.src: 4  Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

en: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
u.src: 4  Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

p.src: 5  which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

ja: る花婿のようであり、 勇士のように、その
en: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
u.src: 5  which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

p.src: 6  His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

ja: てからであり、 その巡る所は天の果てにまで及ぶ。 その
en: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
u.src: 6  His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

p.src: 7  The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

en: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
u.src: 7  The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

p.src: 8  The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

en: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
u.src: 8  The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

p.src: 9  The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

ja: の掟は真実であり、すべて
en: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
u.src: 9  The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

p.src: 10  They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

en: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
u.src: 10  They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

p.src: 11  Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

ja: また、あなたのしもべはそれらによって
en: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
u.src: 11  Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

p.src: 12  Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

ja: ることができるだろうか。
れた過ちを赦してください。
en: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
u.src: 12  Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

p.src: 13  Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

ja: あなたのしもべを、故意の
からも引き留めてください。 それらが
しないようにしてください。 そうすれば、
はまっすぐな者となり、
れて、非の打ちどころのない者となるだろう。
en: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
u.src: 13  Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

p.src: 14  Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.

ja: い巡らしが、 あなたの
れられますように。 わが岩、わが贖い主である主よ。
en: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.
u.src: 14  Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.
